RickardAndreasAgren/ValheimBlueprintCrun.what: a tool for generating damaged/ruined variants of a build, shipped with 21 worked examples by Raimod: tower, fort and cottage families each in intact, damaged, ruined and remnant states. The single best non-base find on the web.
